Chapter 690: Chapter 3: The Cycle of Life and Death Goes On (Please Subscribe)

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.

The commotion caused by the Chikun Star Lord’s successful breakthrough immediately caught the attention of many powerful beings on the main star.

All the Peak Masters sensed it at once and hurried towards the location of the Chikun Star Lord.

There are thirteen Peak Masters in the lineage of Red Kun, with the Great Peak Master and Thirteen Peak Master stationed in other star domains.

Only eleven Peak Masters remain on the main star.

At this moment, with the powerful aura of the Chikun Star Lord spreading, ten Peak Masters were quickly approaching.

...

“Teacher.”

“Teacher, have you made a breakthrough?”

“Congratulations on advancing to the Ninth Rank, Teacher!”

The Peak Masters, upon seeing the Chikun Star Lord standing with hands behind his back and eyes closed, offered their congratulations one after another.

As disciples of the Chikun Star Lord, the more powerful their teacher became, the more benefits they naturally reaped.

In human civilization, the bond between master and disciple is even closer than that of kin, for becoming master and disciple means their life levels won’t differ too much.

They can endure the long years side by side.

But kin? How many of them are still alive, those who are kin to Tenth Rank Evolvers, Eleventh-Rank Evolvers?

Even the kin of Supreme Beings have mostly died, and while Supreme Beings can swim against the current, resurrecting past beings.

However, if they died due to the end of their natural lifespan, even if they were resurrected by force, they would die once again when their time was up.

To achieve eternity, one must become a Twelfth-Rank Life, stepping out of the River of Time.

“You have arrived,” the Chikun Star Lord glanced at the numerous Peak Masters and nodded slightly.

At this moment, his heart was in turmoil, having just connected his consciousness to the virtual world and received countless pieces of information from the past hundred years.

The most dazzling was naturally the Galaxy Master.

Within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he unleashed a massacre, with his power alone, forcing the Ninth-Rank powerhouses of several opposing peak clans of human civilization to willingly die within the secret realm.

Years later, he stepped into the Tenth Rank, and stood near the pinnacle just below the Supreme Beings.

“My disciple…” the Chikun Star Lord fell silent.

Initially, he had merely suggested that Lin Yuan explore the opened Xuanhuang Secret Realm, to see if he could figure out any connection between the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path and the secret realm itself.

He had never anticipated Lin Yuan would cause such a stir.

Back when the Chikun Star Lord entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he was extremely cautious, for an Eighth-Layer invincible being belonged to the lower levels of the secret realm.

But how domineering was Lin Yuan’s performance in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? Those aloof special Ninth Ranks had to scurry away like rats, dying if they were too slow to escape.

As for Lin Yuan stepping into the Tenth Rank, the Chikun Star Lord, despite his complex feelings, secretly felt a sense of relief.

When Lin Yuan had ascended to the Ninth Rank, the Chikun Star Lord was an invincible Eighth Ranker, hoping to impact the Ninth Rank level, to become an Evolver on the same level as his junior disciple.

This was also why the Chikun Star Lord had been in seclusion for over a hundred years.

If not for Lin Yuan’s provocation, perhaps the Chikun Star Lord would have taken a few thousand years to brew.

When naturally reaching the peak, he would then consider advancing to the Ninth Rank.

After all, he had a long lifespan left. As a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun with peak lineage, the Chikun Star Lord’s lifespan was much longer than Evolvers on the same level.

But now?

Lin Yuan had entered the Tenth Rank.

The Chikun Star Lord actually felt a sense of relief because reaching the Tenth Rank level was not something he could achieve by merely entering seclusion.

Even though the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun’s cultivation at the Ninth Rank brought great benefits, opening up numerous Spatial Layers, for one favored by the Origin Source of space, it was considerably easier.

But to completely traverse the Ninth Rank, to open up millions of Spatial Layers?

Without a hundred thousand years, one need not even think about it.

That was if everything went smoothly.

If it didn’t, falling into several bottlenecks could greatly delay the timing.

The Chikun Star Lord’s thoughts were tumultuous, and for a moment, he even felt sentimental.

As long as the gap wasn’t significant, there was the thought of overtaking.

But when the gap became a vast chasm, the Chikun Star Lord completely lost such thoughts.

“Teacher, our junior brother, he has stepped into the Tenth Rank,” the Ten Peak Master immediately said, eager to share the good news with the Chikun Star Lord.

“Hmm.”

“I know,” replied the Chikun Star Lord, giving the Ten Peak Master a glance, “In the future, you all should learn more from Thirteen.”

At these words.

The ten Peak Masters looked at each other in dismay.

Learn from the junior brother?

What could they learn from the junior brother?

…

Deep in the cosmic starry sky.

Within a certain secret realm.

The Tuoba Ancient God was sitting cross-legged, his terrifying aura affecting the surrounding space and time.

“The Galaxy Master, that little fellow, has entered the Tenth Rank?” Tuoba Ancient God had just finished a brief period of seclusion and received this news from human civilization.

“Tuoba.” A powerful consciousness descended, coalescing into a huge phantom figure—it was the Sizhong Ancient God.

“You should have returned the Galaxy Master’s friend back then, and look at how things turned out now. Not only did you not gain any advantage, but you’ve also offended the Galaxy Master,” Sizhong Ancient God said, shaking his head slightly.

“So what if he’s offended?” Tuoba Ancient God didn’t care.

Considering the talent and aptitude shown by the Galaxy Master, it was only natural for him to advance to the Tenth Rank.

Tuoba Ancient God was not worried about this matter at all. Even if the Galaxy Master ascended to Tier 11 in the future, what of it?

As an Ancient God like him, already standing at the zenith of Tier 11, unless the Galaxy Master became a Supreme Being, he couldn’t bother him in the slightest.

But a Supreme Being, was it so easy to become one?

“You may not care about the Galaxy Master, but what about that human Evolver who has comprehended the Rule of Time at the Eleventh Rank? Do you also disregard him?”

“That human Evolver has a great chance of becoming a Supreme Being, and once that happens, the emergence of the tenth Supreme Being from human civilization will have a profound impact on the situation of all major forces in the universe,” Sizhong Ancient God continued.
